notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7; Other Governmental Fund column = Building, Bandstand and Playground Equipment funds); governmental spending is listed by object only. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement total column (pp9-10); business-type reported receipts = operating total + nonoperating net (no single printed total). Detail by fund from the combining receipts (pp11-12), disbursements (pp13-14) and proprietary budget-and-actual (pp15-18) schedules; budgets are printed only as all-fund totals (receipts, proprietary) or per-fund totals (governmental disbursements), so budget_final is null on lines. Water Fund nonoperating lines are below the schedule's Total Operating Receipts (outside_printed_total). Pages 19-20 (combined unaudited summary) repeat fund totals and are not recorded. Balance sheet: governmental from the governmental funds statement (p8; equals the Statement of Net Position governmental column), business-type from the Statement of Net Position (p1).
